title: Company history and network counter
findings: Header reports more than 1760 stores. Use 1760 as a conservative scenario anchor, not an exact census. The separate company page retains older >1600 prose.
limitations: No count of rotisserie-capable stores, daily throughput, or package consumption.

title: Rotisserie equipment capacities
findings: TDR5 capacity 15 basket or 20 meatfork birds based on 1.2 kg; TDR7/8 28 or 40. Supports one 20-bird batch as central daily whole-bird scenario.
limitations: Equipment capacity is not sales; no evidence Profi uses these ovens. Raw versus cooked weight is not transferable without yield.

title: Whole rotisserie chicken
findings: Seller presents a 1.2 kg whole rotisserie product / average 2.75 lb description. Supports approximately 1.2 kg central cooked-bird trial.
limitations: Different market; dimensions absent; 1.0-1.4 kg range is a design assumption.

title: SP31 rotisserie bag 250 x 310 mm
scope: Romanian hot-food price comparator, not B1 material identity
findings: 1.04 RON per bag excluding VAT; 100 per pack; resealable hot-food/rotisserie application; free nationwide shipping over 750 RON excluding VAT; stated 2-4 working days.
limitations: Exact polymer/BOM and thermal dossier absent. Generic virgin-material marketing does not resolve B2 exact all-plastic identity.

title: Euro reference exchange rates 25 September 2026
findings: 1 EUR = 5.2765 RON; 7.4755 DKK; 0.9445 CHF. Scenario FX range 5.0-5.5 RON/EUR is separately assumed.
limitations: Reference rate, not an executable commercial quote.

title: VAT rates September 2025
findings: Standard rate 21% from 1 August 2025. Use 1.21 gross/net factor for separately purchased packaging scenario.
limitations: Commercial comparisons use recoverable-VAT-excluded costs; this is not a transaction-specific tax opinion.

title: NatureFlex product specification / declaration 01505
scope: NVS45 articles including 22249, material/cost analogue only
findings: 22249 is 210 mm x 500 m, 45 micrometre coated regenerated cellulose; coatings fall under EU 10/2011. Hot-fill entries: 70 C/120 min, 80 C/60 min, 90 C/30 min, 100 C/15 min. Remove film before heating. German/French note advises against monoweb storage over 15 min above 70 C; English repeats low-temperature note.
limitations: Not accepted as BIOPAP six-hour film or Gaia liner. Food-contact entries and physical caution must be read together; no six-hour approval. No coating mass.

title: NatureFlex sealing-film price list
findings: Article 22249: 168.31 CHF excluding VAT per reel; 210 mm width. Reel length confirmed separately by declaration, because catalogue field displays malformed 500 mm.
limitations: Swiss list reference only; no Romanian delivery quote or compatibility claim.

title: NatureFlex film grade summary N100
scope: Manufacturer family technical sheet hosted by exhibition
findings: NVS30 yield 23.3 m2/kg; NVS45 yield 15.5 m2/kg. 1000/yield gives basis weight. Heat-seal temperature columns are 0.5-second process settings, not service temperatures.
limitations: Material-mass analogue only; not a nominated Gaia or BIOPAP hot-hold grade.

title: NatureFlex film range
findings: Range includes coated and uncoated cellulose, proprietary barrier layers, and separate ovenable grades; grease/oil barrier and transparency are grade-dependent.
limitations: No exact Gaia liner grade or mass; no generic permission to put NVS45 in oven.

title: ADCOTE laminating-adhesive coating weights
findings: ADCOTE102A lists 1.2-2.0 lb/ream; ADCOTE102E 1.2-2.5. Using explicitly assumed 3000 ft2 packaging ream gives approximately 1.95-4.07 g/m2. Supports nonzero order-of-magnitude coating budget.
limitations: Not a Gaia adhesive or compostability/food-contact analogue; modeled coverage/chemistry remains ASSUMED.

title: LC catalogue
findings: 175 C for up to 60 minutes; grease/oil/sauce resistance claimed. Retain lower published thermal ceiling.
limitations: Historical family document; not six-hour fatty-food finished-system qualification.

title: Intergastra 2026 product news
findings: Current English news claims up to 185 C; retain alongside historical 175 C. Does not identify a revised SI-14 dossier.
limitations: Wider 215 C statements elsewhere concern other scopes and do not supersede SI-14 evidence.

title: Collective catering, German manufacturer page
findings: Published six hours at 90 C and five hours at 100 C family claims. Co-developed film mentioned; precise nominated film code absent.
limitations: Cannot transfer to commercial NVS45 or claim six-hour food safety at Profi.

title: Tray dimensions table
findings: Outside 190 x 247 x 37 mm; opening 176 x 233 mm; bottom 154 x 211 mm; nominal 1240 ml.
limitations: Nominal dimensions do not establish whole-chicken fit.

title: BIOPAP distributor flyer
findings: SI-14 article 65307: 780/carton and 12480/pallet; transparent biofilm 215 mm article 66761 listed.
limitations: Historical selling configuration, no Romanian stock/lead-time commitment; film not identified as NVS45.

title: SI-14 780 trays
findings: 251.79 EUR per 780; confirmed by direct HTTP page read after web tool error. VAT basis not found. Central conservatively treats amount as net; low branch discounts 25% to bracket VAT/quantity ambiguity.
limitations: Body only, no film/freight; not a confirmed RO quote.

title: BIOF22248 NatureFlex roll
scope: Belgian film price and mass analogue
findings: Direct HTTP page: 185 mm x 500 m, 45 micrometre; 177.42 EUR single roll, 172.10 at 5, 166.78 at 10; explicitly not oven resistant.
limitations: 185 mm width cannot cover 190 mm SI-14 outside rim. Transfer EUR/m2 only, to a designed >=210 mm hot-hold film; supplier compatibility and VAT must be confirmed.

title: Oven Ease HC2X40/HC2X70 sell sheet
findings: Page 1 explicitly lists 2, 2.5, 3 mil gauges: 50.8, 63.5, 76.2 micrometre. Used solely for C3 gauge model.
limitations: US 190/204 C and 4-hour statements are not current EMEA C3 thermal evidence; parsed page-2 table is misaligned.

title: Merchandiser product losing temperature
findings: Chicken should enter merchandiser at 82-88 C (180-190 F). Anchors 85 C fill central separately from cabinet stress condition.
limitations: Not Profi process; not six-hour safety/quality validation.

title: Cooking-premises inspection sheet
findings: Section 2.14 cites minimum 60 C for hot dishes, including rotisserie chicken, before service (Order 976/1998 art.37). Search index read; direct web open failed. Corroborating official legislative portal indexed text matches.
limitations: Not a six-hour permission or 90 C cabinet prescription; final applicability and HACCP release require operator QA.

title: T559 cm-22 grease resistance method scope
findings: Kit test is primarily a surface repellency test; applicability to film barriers/nonfluorochemical treatments must be evaluated.
limitations: Do not fabricate kit rating or substitute kit test for six-hour seam leakage.

title: Romania waste profile 2025
findings: Separate collection and treatment gaps constrain actual recovery. Use conditional local-operator routes, no national recovery percentage transferred to packs.
limitations: Does not establish disposal outcome for any exact greasy package.

title: Food-contact framework Regulation 1935/2004
findings: Article 3 requires appropriate safety/inertness under normal or foreseeable use; traceability is required. Engineering mass calculations do not establish compliance.
limitations: Material-specific measures and current amendments must be checked by responsible supplier/lab for actual commercial use.
